## Pull request overview

This PR adds comprehensive design documentation for the Marketplace Protocol, defining the complete lifecycle of metadata-driven package publishing, discovery, installation, and management in the ObjectStack ecosystem. The document serves as the authoritative specification linking together existing schema definitions (`manifest.zod.ts`, `package-registry.zod.ts`, `marketplace.zod.ts`) with real-world usage patterns demonstrated in the HotCRM reference implementation.

**Changes:**
- Added complete 595-line design specification covering architecture, workflows, security model, pricing, and implementation roadmap
- Documented 6-step developer publishing flow and 4-channel customer installation flow with 30+ metadata type registration
- Defined 3 publishing strategies (Suite, Individual, Hybrid) for multi-plugin applications with HotCRM as reference
- Outlined 5-phase implementation roadmap across Q1-Q4 2026 with complexity ratings and deliverables
